description: Verbatim `gh api` GET response bodies consumed by tools/ci/test_workflow_jq_contracts.sh. These are MEASURED inputs — the exact data shapes that fired the Q16/Q17 jq data-shape defects on 2026-11-01. Hand-written mocks are the defect class itself and must not replace them (the harness carries negative controls that fail if these fixtures are sanitized).

schema_basis.claim: Q19 gh --paginate page-shape semantics: official manual says 'Each page is a separate JSON array or object' (+ '--slurp' to wrap); MEASURED on gh 2.102.0: top-level-ARRAY endpoint pages are merged into ONE JSON array (repos/cli/cli/tags?per_page=100 → 210 tags over 3 pages → jq saw exactly 1 document), while object-ENVELOPE endpoints emit each page as a separate JSON object concatenated on stdout (run 41298669695 jobs?per_page=20 → 2 pages → jq -s slurped 2 {total_count,jobs} envelopes). ci-provider-router.yml's `jq -sc '[.[].jobs[]]'` consumes the envelope-concatenation form; release-ship.yml:151 relies on the array-merge form
schema_basis.authority: Context7 MCP (/websites/cli_github_manual, cli.github.com/manual/gh_api, fetched 2026-11-02) for the documented sentence; measured 2026-11-02 (gh 2.102.0, read-only GETs) for both behaviors; docs/spec/ci_provider_failover_quirks.md Q19
